name: Process Heat Unbounded Duty Combination (Manufacturing-only)
trigger_logic: process-load vs support-waste split not evidenced
anti_triggers: process map declares no thermal duty
combined_hypothesis: What looks like inefficient energy intensity may be a structurally bounded process-heat duty that area-normalized benchmarks cannot capture. Trying to compress consumption without splitting structural process load from support-system waste leads to misallocation.
strategic_risk: Retrofit capital is deployed against a denominator that hides the production-bounded thermal duty; savings projections are inflated and operational continuity is risked.
financial_exposure: production continuity risk if process heat is throttled
tad_action: VALIDATE PROCESS HEAT DUTY + COMPARE FAIRLY (not by area) + DO NOT THROTTLE PROCESS YET + PROHIBIT ROI
prohibited_claims: savings claim on whole-site EUI reduction
allowed_language: A bounded structural framing is admissible: thermal economics may be production-bounded while support-systems carry the actual recoverable waste.
tests: manufacturing acceptance bundle should surface this combination when process heat duty is unbounded and the framework presents area-normalized benchmark
must NOT activate in warehouse, cold-chain, office cases (anti-pattern protection by required process-heat patterns)
combination must require run-level adjudication before downstream strategic use
